Thanks for the clear note. We can do a split remittance as suggested: 60% upfront, 40% retained subject to receiving the official WHT certificate from our tax team. 

A couple of quick asks from AP to make posting straightforward: 
- Can you send a remittance stub (CSV preferred) with line-item mappings to INV-7789 and PO# 88912?
- Please confirm the beneficiary name exactly as on your bank account (we use that to validate ACH).
- If the ACH does not clear by Friday EOD CET, we will switch to a wire for the 60% (we need your wire authorization form).

I'll attach the WHT form we will provide once the tax team signs off — I don’t have it yet but expect it by early next week. I can also offer virtual-card payment for the 60% if that speeds things up; let me know if that works on your side (we'll need a MCC acceptance confirmation).
